blocks.title: 01 / Intent becomes inspectable
blocks.text: Fragment keeps a human-readable description, an exact machine model and a printable view together. An unfinished idea remains visibly unfinished. Author: {{ author }}.

blocks.title: 02 / Three views, one meaning
blocks.text: Each view answers a different question without changing the underlying artifact.

figures.label: Intent
figures.explanation: Quick inspection, comments and named concepts.

figures.label: Contract
figures.explanation: Validation, explicit constraints and reproducible tokens.

figures.label: Experience
figures.explanation: Readable print, navigable widgets and a concept map.

blocks.title: 03 / Requirements are not preferences
blocks.text: A missing required capability blocks the affected target. A degradation keeps the artifact usable and explains the fallback. Unknown capabilities are reported explicitly.

blocks.title: 04 / Small enough to read
